Regressions (admin login, #booking hash) still work.

verifications.navbar_links: Home, Performance Booking, Council, Join Us + language switcher all visible

critical_code_review_comments: AdminClubInfo reads session_token cookie directly via document.cookie parsing — works but consider centralizing auth header helper (also used by other admin pages).

PUT /api/club-info accepts full ClubInfo body; there is no partial-update path, so any missing field is reset to Pydantic defaults (0 for counts, '' for text). AdminClubInfo mitigates by seeding form via GET first, so behaviour is correct in the UI, but a raw PUT with partial payload would wipe fields.
seed_data_creation: None — test wrote temp club-info values and restored originals afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite now covers /api/club-info PUT (auth-required + persistence). Sidebar 'Club Info' link goes to /admin/club-info. Homepage Home.jsx line 117 renders clubInfo.about_en/about_zh with hard-coded fallback when empty — confirmed reactive to admin edits.
